source_evidence: Player exact 'what about the pending sales? shouldnt thank have been taken care of?' directs attention to previously authorized and delegated sale logistics. Acknowledge missed follow-through; establish ordinary clerk inquiry and dispatch within elapsed D315–316 under existing authority, not a new historical proof or successful title adjudication. Prior negotiated240gp conditional offer preserved, early key/insignia/signet provisional35gp, total potential275gp not liquid. Confirm actual authority/contact outcome at Orsaven without requiring V to redo routine negotiation. No new V expenditure, sale, cash, physical transfer, game time, independent reply, or guaranteed title. Original explicit title disputes preserved. D320~12:00 westbound Caereth→Orsaven coach route, on Crownsunder side in the militarized frontier approaches, before actual border crossing. V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar and own coach/four horses healthy. D319 ordinary trade road genuine day72 vs15 and exposed night62 vs7 quiet; D319 full travel day supplies15→12 ration person-days,20→16 horse-feed units, overnight weighted LR4→5/6, no full LR. Routine Tamsin exchanges on D319/D320, no specific business outcome inferred. D320 frontier tier day30/night20 fixed prior to genuine roll; day23 triggers occurrence, type79 social. Current leg8 planned days D317–324, cap5, now1 encounter day (D320), consecutive1; no D320 night occurrence roll even if exposed, no full D320 supply debit/overnight yet. At noon roadside stone watering trough near a shared-war memorial, a westbound wool carter and his adult sister from families divided by the frontier have halted to water their team. Carter has made this commercial crossing before, speaks from his own experience that ordinary freight passage continues despite differing loyalties; his sister lives on the other side and wants to visit family graves. No knowledge of V's sealed letter, Kestrel, frontier perpetrators or any privileged official report. He asks V if returning from Caereth and whether they are headed to Orsaven, offers to share crossing conditions from his own experience; no escort contract, quest, fee, threat, mandatory check or claimed fresh raid. V may converse or proceed. G1 shared household traditions and disputed succession/armistice grounded in world/politics/human-states.md; G2 voluntary social encounter with meaningful opportunity to understand local tensions or pass; G3 routine social interaction no combat or prize, no compulsory consequence. Frontier operation geographically distinct, not moved here. All party HP/resources full: V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone; Fenar59/59 AC14 HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6; Cirren51/51 AC18 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 boots; Mara healthy. Purse2903gp4sp6cp; provisions12/16 four days at normal daily usage before D320 charge. Conditional240gp sale unpaid. Sealed diplomatic invitation/limited credentials V-held, Crown intelligence commission active remaining300+1300, Kestrel evidence custody unchanged, Elara Caereth representative, Severin reply pending. Dice delegated until stop. D320 player asks about missed pending sales; resolve previously delegated ordinary clerk follow-through as newly established NPC administrative action, not recovered historic proof of completed sale. Elara's clerk prepared provenance/ownership inquiry with details of recovered Reedbed/Fort goods, prior grant and conditional240gp buyer terms, forwarded it D316 through ordinary household business correspondence to appropriate Orsaven authority/contact; receipt/reply and title clearance unconfirmed. Clerk will coordinate authorized sale without requiring V to negotiate again; at Orsaven arrival check actual title/claims and handover/settlement, verify early three pieces from existing inventory and sell any saleable items at best terms. No custody transfer, no fee charged V, no invented official clearance or cash; personal purse2903gp4sp6cp unchanged. This is an offscreen routine NPC action under existing D315 authorization, not a new V action or elapsed game time; V has not yet received any clerk report on the road. Pending frontier social encounter unchanged.
